name: Voxel Physics Engine
aliases: Abstracted terrain physics engine for voxel games
definition: An abstracted terrain physics engine for voxel games that handles collisions between rigid bodies and solid/liquid voxels. It requires abstracted `(x,y,z) => boolean` test functions for voxel properties.
summary: The Voxel Physics Engine is a lightweight, engine-agnostic rigid-body simulation system for voxel games that uses abstracted boolean tests instead of spatial structures to handle collisions and fluid dynamics.
